shebna_2577.name: Shebna
shebna_2577.who: A royal secretary under King Hezekiah of Judah during the Assyrian siege of Jerusalem.
key: He went out with Eliakim and Joah to meet the Assyrian Rabshakeh at Jerusalem's wall (2 Kings 18).
Hezekiah sent him with Eliakim and the senior priests to seek the prophet Isaiah (2 Kings 19).
Isaiah records the same meeting with the Rabshakeh, naming him as the secretary (Isaiah 36).
He carried Hezekiah's request for prayer to Isaiah, who promised the Lord's deliverance (Isaiah 37).

shelah_2593.name: Shelah
shelah_2593.who: The third son of Judah by the daughter of Shua, and ancestor of the Shelanite clan.
key: He was born to Judah and the daughter of Shua at Chezib (Genesis 38).
Judah withheld him from marrying the widowed Tamar, fearing he too would die (Genesis 38).
He went down to Egypt with Jacob's household (Genesis 46).
His descendants formed the clan of the Shelanites in the tribe of Judah (Numbers 26).
His descendants included linen workers and potters who served the king (1 Chronicles 4).

tubal_2883.name: Tubal
tubal_2883.who: A son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, whose descendants became a distant northern people.
key: He is listed among the sons of Japheth in the table of nations (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats his place among Japheth's sons (1 Chronicles 1).
Tubal is named among distant nations who will hear of the Lord's glory (Isaiah 66).
Tubal traded slaves and bronze vessels with the city of Tyre (Ezekiel 27).
Gog is called chief prince of Meshech and Tubal in Ezekiel's prophecy (Ezekiel 38).

uzzah_2916.name: Uzzah
uzzah_2916.who: A son of Abinadab who died when he touched the ark of God as David moved it.
key: He and his brother Ahio drove the new cart carrying the ark from Abinadab's house (2 Samuel 6).
When the oxen stumbled, he took hold of the ark, and God struck him dead (2 Samuel 6).
David was angry and afraid, and named the place Perez-uzzah (2 Samuel 6).
Chronicles records the same event during David's first attempt to bring up the ark (1 Chronicles 13).

zimri_3088.name: Zimri
zimri_3088.who: A chariot commander who assassinated King Elah and ruled Israel for only seven days.
key: He conspired against King Elah and killed him while Elah was drunk in Tirzah (1 Kings 16).
As king he struck down the entire house of Baasha, as the prophet Jehu had foretold (1 Kings 16).
When Omri besieged Tirzah, Zimri burned the king's house over himself and died (1 Kings 16).
Jezebel later taunted Jehu by calling him Zimri, murderer of his master (2 Kings 9).

achan_61.name: Achan
achan_61.who: A man of Judah, son of Carmi, who took devoted things from Jericho and brought trouble on Israel.
key: He secretly took a cloak, silver, and gold devoted to the Lord from Jericho (Joshua 7).
Because of his sin, Israel was defeated at Ai (Joshua 7).
Identified by lot, he confessed and was stoned in the Valley of Achor (Joshua 7).
His sin was later recalled as a warning that wrath fell on all Israel (Joshua 22).
Chronicles calls him the troubler of Israel (1 Chronicles 2).

ahaziah_120.name: Ahaziah
ahaziah_120.who: A son of Ahab who reigned two years as king of Israel and served Baal.
key: He became king in Samaria, did evil, and served Baal as his parents had (1 Kings 22).
Jehoshaphat joined him in building ships at Ezion-geber, but the ships were wrecked (2 Chronicles 20).
After falling through a lattice, he sent to inquire of Baal-zebub, god of Ekron (2 Kings 1).
Elijah declared he would die, and fire from heaven consumed two companies sent to seize Elijah (2 Kings 1).
He died as Elijah had said, and his brother Jehoram succeeded him (2 Kings 1).

amos_238.name: Amos
amos_238.who: A shepherd from Tekoa whom the Lord called to prophesy against Israel and the nations.
key: He prophesied in the days of Uzziah and Jeroboam, two years before the earthquake (Amos 1).
He saw visions of locusts, fire, and a plumb line, and interceded for Israel (Amos 7).
Amaziah the priest of Bethel accused him of conspiracy and told him to leave (Amos 7).
Amos replied he was a herdsman whom the Lord took from following the flock (Amos 7).
He saw a basket of summer fruit, signaling that Israel's end had come (Amos 8).

barzillai_411.name: Barzillai
barzillai_411.who: A wealthy elderly Gileadite of Rogelim who supplied David during Absalom's rebellion.
key: He brought beds, food, and supplies to David and his people at Mahanaim (2 Samuel 17).
At eighty years old he declined David's invitation to live in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 19).
He asked David to take his servant Chimham in his place (2 Samuel 19).
David charged Solomon to show kindness to Barzillai's sons for his loyalty (1 Kings 2).

bela_436.name: Bela
bela_436.who: The firstborn son of Benjamin and head of the Belaite clan.
key: He is listed among the sons of Benjamin who went to Egypt with Jacob (Genesis 46).
His descendants formed the clan of the Belaites in the tribe of Benjamin (Numbers 26).
His sons were heads of fathers' houses and mighty warriors (1 Chronicles 7).
Chronicles names him as Benjamin's firstborn and lists his sons (1 Chronicles 8).

cainan_534.name: Kenan
cainan_534.who: A son of Enosh and father of Mahalalel in the line from Adam to Noah.
key: He was born when his father Enosh was ninety years old (Genesis 5).
He fathered Mahalalel at seventy and lived 910 years (Genesis 5).
Chronicles lists him in the genealogy from Adam (1 Chronicles 1).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

caleb_538.name: Caleb
caleb_538.who: A son of Hezron of the tribe of Judah, whose wives and many descendants are listed in Chronicles.
key: He is named, as Chelubai, among the sons of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2).
He fathered children by Azubah and later married Ephrath, who bore Hur (1 Chronicles 2).
Through Hur his line led to Bezalel, the craftsman of the tabernacle (1 Chronicles 2).
His sons by his concubines Ephah and Maacah are also recorded (1 Chronicles 2).
Descendants of Hur, firstborn of Ephrathah, include the founder of Bethlehem (1 Chronicles 4).

dagon_969.name: Dagon
dagon_969.who: The chief god of the Philistines, not a person.

daughter_of_lot_younger_984.name: Lot's younger daughter
daughter_of_lot_younger_984.who: The younger daughter of Lot, who fled Sodom with him and became the mother of Ben-ammi.
key: Angels led her, her sister, and her parents out of Sodom before its destruction (Genesis 19).
She and her sister lived with Lot in a cave in the hills near Zoar (Genesis 19).
Following her sister's plan, she made Lot drunk and lay with him (Genesis 19).
She bore Ben-ammi, the father of the Ammonites (Genesis 19).

daughter_of_pharaoh_988.name: Pharaoh's daughter
daughter_of_pharaoh_988.who: The Egyptian princess who found the infant Moses in the Nile and raised him as her son.
key: She found the baby Moses in a basket among the reeds and took pity on him (Exodus 2).
At Miriam's suggestion, she paid Moses' own mother to nurse him (Exodus 2).
She adopted him as her son and named him Moses (Exodus 2).
Stephen recalled that she brought Moses up as her own son (Acts 7).
By faith Moses later refused to be called her son (Hebrews 11).

elihu_1130.name: Elihu
elihu_1130.who: A young man, son of Barachel the Buzite, who spoke after Job and his three friends fell silent.
key: Angry at Job and his three friends, he waited for his elders before speaking (Job 32).
He insisted that God does not act wickedly or pervert justice (Job 34).
He argued that human righteousness or sin does not add to or harm God (Job 35).
He declared that God is great beyond understanding and teaches through affliction (Job 36).

jared_730.name: Jared
jared_730.who: A son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch in the line from Adam to Noah.
key: He was born when his father Mahalalel was sixty-five (Genesis 5).
He fathered Enoch at 162 and lived 962 years (Genesis 5).
Chronicles lists him in the genealogy from Adam (1 Chronicles 1).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

javan_744.name: Javan
javan_744.who: A son of Japheth whose descendants became coastland peoples; his name later designates Greece.
key: He is listed among the sons of Japheth, with sons Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats his line among Japheth's descendants (1 Chronicles 1).
Javan is named among distant nations who will hear of the Lord's glory (Isaiah 66).
Javan traded slaves and bronze vessels with the city of Tyre (Ezekiel 27).

jonadab_1688.name: Jonadab
jonadab_1688.who: A nephew of David and a very crafty friend of Amnon.
key: He was the son of David's brother Shimeah and a friend of Amnon (2 Samuel 13).
He advised Amnon to pretend illness so Tamar would come to him (2 Samuel 13).
After Absalom killed Amnon, he told David that only Amnon was dead (2 Samuel 13).
He said Absalom had planned it since the day Amnon violated Tamar (2 Samuel 13).

lamech_1809.name: Lamech
lamech_1809.who: A son of Methuselah and the father of Noah in the line from Adam.
key: He fathered a son at 182 and named him Noah (Genesis 5).
He hoped Noah would bring relief from the painful toil of the cursed ground (Genesis 5).
He lived 777 years and fathered other sons and daughters (Genesis 5).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

mahalaleel_1885.name: Mahalalel
mahalaleel_1885.who: A son of Kenan and father of Jared in the line from Adam to Noah.
key: He was born when his father Kenan was seventy (Genesis 5).
He fathered Jared at sixty-five and lived 895 years (Genesis 5).
Chronicles lists him in the genealogy from Adam (1 Chronicles 1).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

meshech_2012.name: Meshech
meshech_2012.who: A son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, whose descendants became a distant northern people.
key: He is listed among the sons of Japheth in the table of nations (Genesis 10).
Meshech traded slaves and bronze vessels with the city of Tyre (Ezekiel 27).
Ezekiel names Meshech and Tubal among the nations brought down to the pit (Ezekiel 32).
Gog is called chief prince of Meshech and Tubal in Ezekiel's prophecy (Ezekiel 38).
The Lord declares he will turn Gog back and bring him down (Ezekiel 39).

methuselah_2042.name: Methuselah
methuselah_2042.who: A son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah, the longest-lived person recorded in Scripture.
key: He was born when his father Enoch was sixty-five (Genesis 5).
He fathered Lamech at 187 and lived 969 years in all (Genesis 5).
Chronicles lists him in the genealogy from Adam (1 Chronicles 1).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

nahor_2142.name: Nahor
nahor_2142.who: A son of Serug and the father of Terah, making him Abraham's grandfather.
key: He was born when his father Serug was thirty (Genesis 11).
He fathered Terah at twenty-nine and lived 148 years in all (Genesis 11).
Chronicles lists him in the line from Shem to Abraham (1 Chronicles 1).
Luke includes him in the genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

pharaoh-nechoh_2337.name: Pharaoh Neco
pharaoh-nechoh_2337.who: A king of Egypt who killed King Josiah at Megiddo and then controlled Judah's throne.
key: He marched toward the Euphrates, and King Josiah was killed opposing him at Megiddo (2 Kings 23).
He warned Josiah that God had sent him, but Josiah would not listen (2 Chronicles 35).
He imprisoned King Jehoahaz at Riblah and imposed tribute on Judah (2 Kings 23).
He made Eliakim king, renamed him Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz to Egypt (2 Chronicles 36).
Nebuchadnezzar later defeated his army at Carchemish by the Euphrates (Jeremiah 46).

rahab_2388.name: Rahab
rahab_2388.who: A prostitute of Jericho who hid Israel's spies and was spared when the city fell.
key: She hid two Israelite spies on her roof and sent the king's men away (Joshua 2).
She confessed that the Lord is God in heaven above and on earth (Joshua 2).
Marked by a scarlet cord, her household was spared when Jericho fell (Joshua 6).
She is commended for welcoming the spies by faith (Hebrews 11).
James cites her as justified by works in receiving the messengers (James 2).

rechab_2403.name: Rechab
rechab_2403.who: The father of Jonadab and the ancestor of the Rechabites.
key: His son Jehonadab joined Jehu in his zeal against the worship of Baal (2 Kings 10).
His son Jonadab commanded his descendants not to drink wine and to live in tents (Jeremiah 35).
Jeremiah held up the obedient Rechabites as a rebuke to disobedient Judah (Jeremiah 35).
The Lord promised that Jonadab son of Rechab would never lack a man to serve him (Jeremiah 35).

shimei_2699.name: Shimei
shimei_2699.who: A son of Gershon and grandson of Levi, ancestor of the Levite clan of the Shimeites.
key: He is listed with his brother Libni as a son of Gershon (Exodus 6).
His descendants formed the Shimeite clan among the Gershonites (Numbers 3).
Chronicles lists him among the sons of Gershon (1 Chronicles 6).
His sons are named in David's organization of the Levites (1 Chronicles 23).
The clan of the Shimeites is named among those who will mourn (Zechariah 12).

stephen_2802.name: Stephen
stephen_2802.who: One of the seven chosen to serve the Jerusalem church, and the first Christian martyr.
key: He was chosen among the seven, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit (Acts 6).
Opponents who could not withstand his wisdom brought false charges before the council (Acts 6).
He recounted Israel's history, saw Jesus at God's right hand, and was stoned (Acts 7).
Saul approved his execution, and persecution scattered the church (Acts 8).
Paul later confessed he had stood by approving when Stephen was killed (Acts 22).

tamar_2821.name: Tamar
tamar_2821.who: The daughter-in-law of Judah who bore him the twins Perez and Zerah.
key: She married Judah's son Er, and after his death his brother Onan (Genesis 38).
When Judah withheld Shelah, she disguised herself and conceived by Judah (Genesis 38).
Judah declared she was more righteous than he (Genesis 38).
She bore twins, Perez and Zerah (Genesis 38).
She is named in the genealogy of Jesus (Matthew 1).

the_giant_in_gath_2848.name: the giants of Gath
the_giant_in_gath_2848.who: Refers to the race of giants at Gath from whom several Philistine warriors descended, not a single person.

zechariah_3004.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3004.who: A Levite gatekeeper, firstborn son of Meshelemiah, who served at the tent of meeting.
key: He was gatekeeper at the entrance of the tent of meeting (1 Chronicles 9).
He is named as the firstborn son of Meshelemiah among the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 26).
Described as a shrewd counselor, he received the north gate by lot (1 Chronicles 26).

zilpah_3081.name: Zilpah
zilpah_3081.who: Leah's servant, given to Jacob as a wife, and mother of Gad and Asher.
key: Laban gave Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her servant (Genesis 29).
Leah gave her to Jacob, and she bore Gad and Asher (Genesis 30).
Her sons are listed among the twelve sons of Jacob (Genesis 35).
Young Joseph worked with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah (Genesis 37).
Her descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob numbered sixteen (Genesis 46).

zippor_3094.name: Zippor
zippor_3094.who: The father of Balak, the king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.
key: His son Balak saw Israel's victories and feared them (Numbers 22).
Balaam addressed Balak as son of Zippor in his oracle of blessing (Numbers 23).
Joshua recalled how Balak son of Zippor fought against Israel (Joshua 24).
Jephthah cited Balak son of Zippor in his message to the Ammonites (Judges 11).

adah_414.name: Adah
adah_414.who: A Hittite wife of Esau, daughter of Elon, and mother of Eliphaz.
key: Esau's marriage to a daughter of Elon the Hittite grieved Isaac and Rebekah (Genesis 26).
She is named as Esau's wife, the daughter of Elon the Hittite (Genesis 36).
She bore Esau his son Eliphaz (Genesis 36).
Her grandsons through Eliphaz became chiefs in Edom (Genesis 36).

ahimelech_149.name: Ahimelech
ahimelech_149.who: A son of Abiathar who served as a priest alongside Zadok during David's reign.
key: He and Zadok are listed as priests in David's administration (2 Samuel 8).
Chronicles repeats his place as priest among David's officials (1 Chronicles 18).
With David and Zadok, he organized the priests into divisions (1 Chronicles 24).
Lots for the Levites were also cast in his presence (1 Chronicles 24).

ahinoam_153.name: Ahinoam
ahinoam_153.who: A woman of Jezreel who became David's wife and the mother of his firstborn son, Amnon.
key: David married Ahinoam of Jezreel (1 Samuel 25).
She lived with David among the Philistines at Gath (1 Samuel 27).
Amalekites captured her at Ziklag, and David rescued her (1 Samuel 30).
She went with David to Hebron when he became king of Judah (2 Samuel 2).
She bore Amnon, David's firstborn son, at Hebron (2 Samuel 3).

ammihud_223.name: Ammihud
ammihud_223.who: An Ephraimite, father of Elishama the tribal leader, and an ancestor of Joshua.
key: His son Elishama was appointed leader of Ephraim for the census (Numbers 1).
Elishama son of Ammihud led Ephraim's camp on the west side (Numbers 2).
His son brought Ephraim's offering on the seventh day (Numbers 7).
He appears in the Ephraimite line leading to Joshua son of Nun (1 Chronicles 7).

aquila_279.name: Aquila
aquila_279.who: A Jewish believer from Pontus, a tentmaker who with his wife Priscilla worked alongside Paul.
key: Expelled from Rome under Claudius, he and Priscilla worked with Paul as tentmakers in Corinth (Acts 18).
In Ephesus they explained the way of God more accurately to Apollos (Acts 18).
Paul said they risked their necks for him, and a church met in their house (Romans 16).
They sent greetings with the church in their house to Corinth (1 Corinthians 16).
Paul sent them greetings in his final letter (2 Timothy 4).

bashemath_1887.name: Basemath
bashemath_1887.who: A wife of Esau, daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth, and mother of Reuel.
key: To please Isaac, Esau married a daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth (Genesis 28).
She is named as Esau's wife, Ishmael's daughter (Genesis 36).
She bore Esau his son Reuel (Genesis 36).
Her grandsons through Reuel became chiefs in Edom (Genesis 36).

cush_962.name: Cush
cush_962.who: A son of Ham and grandson of Noah, the father of Nimrod; his name later designates a land south of Egypt.
key: He is listed as the first son of Ham in the table of nations (Genesis 10).
His sons were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca (Genesis 10).
He fathered Nimrod, the first mighty man on earth (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats his line among Ham's descendants (1 Chronicles 1).

delilah_1005.name: Delilah
delilah_1005.who: A woman of the Valley of Sorek whom Samson loved and who betrayed him to the Philistines.
key: Samson loved Delilah, who lived in the Valley of Sorek (Judges 16).
Philistine lords each offered her silver to learn the secret of his strength (Judges 16).
Three times she tried to bind him, and three times he deceived her (Judges 16).
Pressed daily, he told her the truth, and she had his head shaved (Judges 16).
The Philistines seized Samson, gouged out his eyes, and imprisoned him (Judges 16).

ebed-melech_1029.name: Ebed-melech
ebed-melech_1029.who: An Ethiopian eunuch in King Zedekiah's palace who rescued Jeremiah from a muddy cistern.
key: He appealed to King Zedekiah on behalf of Jeremiah, left to die in a cistern (Jeremiah 38).
With thirty men and old rags, he drew Jeremiah up out of the cistern (Jeremiah 38).
The Lord promised to deliver him when Jerusalem fell because he trusted in the Lord (Jeremiah 39).

eliab_1073.name: Eliab
eliab_1073.who: A son of Helon who served as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun in the wilderness.
key: He was appointed to help Moses take the census for Zebulun (Numbers 1).
He led Zebulun's camp on the east side of the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
He brought Zebulun's offering for the altar on the third day (Numbers 7).
He commanded Zebulun's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

elimelech_1134.name: Elimelech
elimelech_1134.who: An Ephrathite of Bethlehem, husband of Naomi, who moved his family to Moab during a famine.
key: During a famine he took Naomi and their two sons from Bethlehem to Moab (Ruth 1).
He died in Moab, leaving Naomi with her two sons (Ruth 1).
Boaz was a wealthy relative from Elimelech's clan (Ruth 2).
Boaz acquired from Naomi all that had belonged to Elimelech (Ruth 4).

eliphaz_1145.name: Eliphaz
eliphaz_1145.who: Eliphaz the Temanite, one of the three friends who came to comfort Job.
key: He came with Bildad and Zophar to comfort Job and sat silently seven days (Job 2).
Speaking first, he argued that the innocent do not perish (Job 4).
He charged Job with undermining the fear of God (Job 15).
He accused Job of great wickedness and urged him to return to God (Job 22).
The Lord rebuked him and his friends, and Job prayed for them (Job 42).

elishama_1155.name: Elishama
elishama_1155.who: A son of Ammihud who led the tribe of Ephraim in the wilderness, and grandfather of Joshua.
key: He was appointed to help Moses take the census for Ephraim (Numbers 1).
He led Ephraim's camp on the west side of the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
He brought Ephraim's offering for the altar on the seventh day (Numbers 7).
He commanded Ephraim's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).
Chronicles lists him as the father of Nun and grandfather of Joshua (1 Chronicles 7).

er_1209.name: Er
er_1209.who: The firstborn son of Judah, whom the Lord put to death for his wickedness.
key: He was born to Judah and the daughter of Shua (Genesis 38).
Judah took Tamar as his wife (Genesis 38).
He was wicked in the Lord's sight, and the Lord put him to death (Genesis 38).
He is listed among Judah's sons who died in Canaan (Genesis 46).

goliath_1327.name: Goliath
goliath_1327.who: The giant Philistine champion of Gath whom young David killed with a sling and a stone.
key: For forty days he defied the armies of Israel and challenged them to send a champion (1 Samuel 17).
David struck him with a stone from his sling and cut off his head (1 Samuel 17).
Ahimelech the priest gave David Goliath's sword at Nob (1 Samuel 21).
Elhanan later struck down Lahmi, the brother of Goliath (1 Chronicles 20).

heber_1469.name: Heber
heber_1469.who: A grandson of Asher, son of Beriah, and ancestor of the Heberite clan.
key: He is listed among Asher's descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob (Genesis 46).
His descendants formed the clan of the Heberites in Asher (Numbers 26).
He fathered Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua (1 Chronicles 7).

herod_1506.name: Herod Agrippa I
herod_1506.who: The king, called Herod in Acts, who killed James, imprisoned Peter, and was struck down by God.
key: He killed James the brother of John with the sword (Acts 12).
Seeing it pleased the Jews, he arrested Peter during Passover (Acts 12).
After an angel freed Peter, Herod had the guards put to death (Acts 12).
When people hailed his voice as a god's, an angel struck him and he died (Acts 12).

ittai_656.name: Ittai
ittai_656.who: Ittai the Gittite, a foreigner from Gath who stayed loyal to David during Absalom's rebellion.
key: David urged him to return home, but he vowed to stay with David in life or death (2 Samuel 15).
He crossed the Kidron with his men and their little ones (2 Samuel 15).
David gave him command of a third of the army against Absalom (2 Samuel 18).
David ordered him, Joab, and Abishai to deal gently with Absalom (2 Samuel 18).

jabin_677.name: Jabin
jabin_677.who: A king of Canaan reigning in Hazor who oppressed Israel in the days of Deborah.
key: The Lord sold Israel into his hand, and he oppressed them twenty years (Judges 4).
His commander Sisera led nine hundred chariots of iron (Judges 4).
God subdued Jabin before Israel, who pressed on until they destroyed him (Judges 4).
The psalmist asks God to deal with Israel's enemies as with Sisera and Jabin (Psalms 83).

jael_689.name: Jael
jael_689.who: The wife of Heber the Kenite, who killed the Canaanite commander Sisera in her tent.
key: Sisera fled to her tent, since Jabin was at peace with Heber's house (Judges 4).
She gave him milk, covered him, and drove a tent peg through his temple (Judges 4).
She showed the pursuing Barak the man he was seeking (Judges 4).
Deborah's song calls her most blessed of women (Judges 5).

jerahmeel_843.name: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel_843.who: The firstborn son of Hezron of Judah, whose descendants are listed in Chronicles.
key: He is named first among the sons of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2).
His sons were Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah (1 Chronicles 2).
By another wife, Atarah, he fathered Onam (1 Chronicles 2).

joah_1621.name: Joah
joah_1621.who: A son of Asaph who served as recorder under King Hezekiah of Judah.
key: He went out with Eliakim and Shebna to meet the Assyrian Rabshakeh (2 Kings 18).
They asked the Rabshakeh to speak in Aramaic rather than in Hebrew (2 Kings 18).
They returned to Hezekiah with torn clothes and reported his words (Isaiah 36).

joktan_1686.name: Joktan
joktan_1686.who: A son of Eber and brother of Peleg, ancestor of thirteen Arabian peoples.
key: He was born to Eber, and his brother Peleg was named for the earth's division (Genesis 10).
He fathered thirteen sons, including Sheba, Ophir, and Havilah (Genesis 10).
His descendants lived in the hill country of the east (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats his line among Shem's descendants (1 Chronicles 1).

jonathan_1693.name: Jonathan
jonathan_1693.who: A son of the priest Abiathar who served as a messenger for David during Absalom's revolt.
key: David sent him back to Jerusalem with Ahimaaz to bring him word (2 Samuel 15).
Hiding in a well at Bahurim, he escaped and warned David to cross the Jordan (2 Samuel 17).
He reported to Adonijah that David had made Solomon king (1 Kings 1).

joseph_1716.name: Joseph of Arimathea
joseph_1716.who: A rich council member and disciple of Jesus who buried Jesus' body in his own new tomb.
key: A rich disciple from Arimathea, he laid Jesus in his own new rock tomb (Matthew 27).
A respected council member, he boldly asked Pilate for Jesus' body (Mark 15).
He had not consented to the council's decision and was looking for God's kingdom (Luke 23).
Once a secret disciple, he and Nicodemus wrapped Jesus' body with spices (John 19).

meraioth_2003.name: Meraioth
meraioth_2003.who: A priest descended from Aaron through Eleazar, listed in the line of the high priests.
key: He was the son of Zerahiah and father of Amariah in Aaron's line (1 Chronicles 6).
His name appears in the priestly ancestry of Ezra the scribe (Ezra 7).

meremoth_2006.name: Meremoth
meremoth_2006.who: A priest, son of Uriah, who served in Jerusalem in the days of Ezra and Nehemiah.
key: He received and weighed the silver and gold brought to the temple by Ezra's group (Ezra 8).
He repaired two sections of Jerusalem's wall, one beside Eliashib's house (Nehemiah 3).
A priest named Meremoth set his seal on the covenant renewal (Nehemiah 10).

milcah_2082.name: Milcah
milcah_2082.who: A daughter of Haran, wife of Abraham's brother Nahor, and grandmother of Rebekah.
key: She was the daughter of Haran and married Nahor, Abraham's brother (Genesis 11).
She bore eight sons to Nahor, including Bethuel, father of Rebekah (Genesis 22).
Rebekah identified herself to Abraham's servant as the granddaughter of Milcah (Genesis 24).
